# vendorfake

> Fakes of third-party vendor APIs for testing an integration
> without a vendor sandbox: real state, webhooks signed and retried the way
> the vendor does it, and deterministic fault injection.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any vendor
named here. Every behaviour is derived from publicly published API
documentation. Four vendors ship today: Square (Connect v2), Clover
(REST v3), Toast (REST v2/v3), Lightspeed Retail X-Series (API 2026-07).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/README.md):
  what vendorfake is, the vendors it covers, the sixty-second quickstart, and
  links into the docs site for everything else.
- [Unit](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/concepts/unit.md):
  the vocabulary a consumer needs -- unit, profile, capabilities and roles,
  driver, journal and request log, clock -- plus the discovery commands that
  answer what a unit serves without starting one.
- [API contract](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/api-contract.md):
  what is public and covered by the deprecation policy, what is internal and
  may move without notice -- the one page that answers "if I import it, will
  it still be there next release?"
- [Seed](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/concepts/seed.md):
  the typed `.seed` attribute, seed overlays, and the exact ids, credentials
  and entities every profile starts with, per vendor.
- [Chaos](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/concepts/chaos.md):
  chaos rules and the fault catalogue, the in-band `chaos:` triggers a vendor
  SDK can reach, and the provenance labels every answer carries.
- [Lightspeed Retail X-Series](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/vendors/lightspeed.md):
  the per-vendor page for the newest surface -- what it covers, transcripts
  from a served unit, the five places the vendor's own document contradicts
  itself and this fake reproduces it, the capability table, and every judgment
  call with the page that is silent about it.
- [Which binding to use](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/start/bindings.md):
  the four bindings (in-process sync, in-process async, served, container),
  the `vendorfake` pytest marker and its three fixtures, docker compose, CI,
  and TLS termination.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  what changed, release by release.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  for an agent working inside this repository itself (layout, the one
  command, the boundary rules) -- not relevant to a consumer.
